transitions.authority: kovee (C2): the byom kernel initiates at resource_allocate (family contract L31) under the pinned realm binding epoch; Kovee executes the reservation — Kovee platform capacity lives under another owner and is never part of the byom transaction (§11.4)
transitions.notes: The idempotent bridge saga persists the ExternalBudgetBridge with stable_external_reservation_key before queueing (§11.4). The subordinate request may narrow or deny but never parallel-charge the same use; every item pins its exact parent §11.4 reservation item and NEVER exceeds parent_worst_case_amount (runner cross-member check; SubordinateReservation.tla NeverAboveParent).
Exact retry under the same stable_external_reservation_key returns the identical pending request — never a second reservation row (SubordinateReservation.tla CreateOnce).

transitions.authority: kovee (C2): Kovee durably commits the exact subordinate reservation (possibly narrowed) and returns its ref, revision, and digest, persisted on the bridge (§11.4)
transitions.notes: Queueing requires BOTH exact reservation sets (§11.4); the byom parent stays reserved the whole time (no parallel charge, no early release).
A denial releases only demonstrably unspent Byom reservations (§11.4).

transitions.authority: kovee (C2): transport loss or unknown result — a recorded fact, not a decision
transitions.notes: An unknown result remains uncertain (§11.4): the byom reservation is NOT released, spend stays blocked, and only the stable query or the R38 governance seat resolves it — guessing is not a transition.

kovee (C2): the stable query returns the exact committed subordinate reservation — verification, not authority
transitions.notes: Resolves to what actually happened; the bridge persists the recovered ref/revision/digest.

transitions.authority: kovee (C2): the stable query proves the reservation was never created (Kovee's durable idempotency state for the stable key)
transitions.notes: Only a verified absence drives the deny; the released amount is exactly the demonstrably unspent byom reservation.

transitions.authority: governance (R38): the exact reconciliation seat with a fresh challenge for ambiguous release; services prepare evidence only
transitions.notes: The only release from uncertain (family contract L33): a governance decision, never a timeout. Disagreement or a stale lease blocks spend until this seat decides.

transitions.authority: kovee (C2): measured settlement from a trusted broker meter or independently verified provider receipt — participant and worker reports are evidence, not meters (§11.4/L33)
transitions.notes: Monotonic, stable-keyed, applied once on BOTH sides (SubordinateReservation.tla SettleOnce); charged never exceeds the reserved amount. Unknown or underivable cost keeps the reservation or settles to the conservative maximum.

transitions.authority: kovee (C2): both sides release an unspent confirmed reservation when the work never queues (episode canceled before launch)
transitions.notes: Releases only demonstrably unspent quantity; the parent bucket returns in the same accounting step.

transitions.authority: kovee (C2): saga completion after a definite denial
transitions.notes: Terminal bookkeeping row; nothing was ever charged.

Releases the reserved remainder above the settled charge; released_lifetime is a monotonic audit counter, not an available bucket (§11.4). Terminal: a released bridge never revives — new work is a fresh saga row under a fresh stable key.
